full_name: Nancy F. Cott | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Nancy F. Cott teaches at Harvard University, where she is the Jonathan Trumbull Professor of American History. Her writings range widely over questions concerning women, gender, marriage, feminism, and citizenship from the 18th-century to the contemporary United States.
